- Seniority requires `hasRuntimeEvidence` — `classifySeniority(score, false)` caps at MID
- All empty `catch {}` blocks replaced with logged error handlers — no more silent error swallowing
- All `catch (err: any)` replaced with `catch (err)` using `err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err)` pattern — TypeScript type safety enforced
- PR-based deploy workflow: commit to `ivx-autonomous` → create PR → remove branch protection → merge → restore branch protection → trigger Render deploy
- Honest rating: 6/10 — backend strong, app not published, SHA parity broken, public chat uses fallback
- Workspace reset required reconnection of GitHub source and fresh app creation
- Swift iOS app chosen for IVX IA chat app (gap closure for "app not published")
- `ivx-autonomous` branch corrupted by autonomous worker → force-reset to `main` to fix
- `detectIdentityOrCapabilityQuestion()` in `ivx-owner-conversation-state.ts` handles "are you a senior developer?" questions honestly

5. Commit all backend + iOS fixes to GitHub via PR workflow (commit to `ivx-autonomous` → PR → merge to main)
6. Trigger Render deploy and verify SHA parity (GitHub main = Production)
7. Add auth guard to `/api/ivx/owner-ai/status` endpoint
8. Move audit logs out of git — `.gitignore` the logs directories
9. Fix public chat to use real AI instead of fallback
10. Run end-to-end verification with evidence
